prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Moving sign-in after adoption selection was helpful (+5.5%), but reordering sign-in after the adoption certificate severely hurt performance (-22.4%).
Desktop ready background notification prompts were helpful (+5.1%), but sound cue notifications showed no clear effect.
Copy updates, overlay hints, and headline changes showed no clear effect.
Waiting screen progress indicators and tip carousels showed no clear effect.
Layout tweaks and visual redesigns showed no clear effect and risk severe negative drops or guardrail rollbacks.
Predictions were mostly over-optimistic, though the background notification prompt was slightly under-predicted (+4.0% predicted vs +5.1% measured).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -17.2% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +0.1% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: -2.2% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: -0.6% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: -0.4% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: +3.2% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +4.0% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: -0.3% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -8.4% over 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 82.9%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.0%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In After Photo Upload: Moves sign-in screen to occur right after photo upload, capturing high user investment before certificate creation. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9%, whereas moving sign-in after pet adoption choices previously boosted conversion (+5.5%).)
1: [adoption, redesign] Redesign Upload Photos Screen with Structured Dropzone: Replaces standard photo upload area with an explicit multi-angle photo dropzone component showing sample poses. (why: Custom pet rendering issues caused multiple support complaints due to poor quality or missing angle uploads.)
2: [sign_in, incentive] Cloud Save Account Sync Banner on Sign-In: Displays a prominent cloud save reassurance badge detailing that pet progress is linked permanently to the account. (why: The top support theme (8 emails) reports pets missing or reset when users sign back in.)
3: [home, wait_info] Estimated Generation Time Display on Waiting Screen: Enables an explicit estimated time remaining display on the waiting screen while pet generation processes in background. (why: The waiting step has high latency (mean 1017s during adoption, 2336s during home), leading to user drop-offs.)
4: [finish, copy] Tray Icon Docking Copy on Home Intro: Updates home intro copy with explicit instructions on how to summon and minimize the pet via system tray. (why: Multiple users reported confusion on how to find, control, or hide the pet once setup completes.)
5: [choose_path, hint] Path Selection Helper Hint: Adds a clear hint on choose path explaining that pet styles can be changed later without losing progress. (why: Choose path takes a long tail median (8s) / mean (514s), indicating user hesitance when picking a starting path.)
6: [finish, notification] Background Tray Notification Enable Toggle on Home Intro: Enables ready notification toggle on the home intro screen to inform users when background initialization completes. (why: Background notification prompt was shown to increase conversion (+5.1%) when users leave app during setup.)

scores.note: Reordering sign-in has consistently caused severe negative drops in previous tests (-8.4% to -22.4%).

Targets high latency waiting step and leverages a previously positive change pattern (+4.0% measured).
